# Thalius Hippocampus

> An expert on your company's documents: complex questions across many files, answered with the page.

Hippocampus is a remote MCP server at https://hippocampus.thalius.ai/mcp. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser; a free Thalius account works. The assistant acts as the signed-in person.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is and how to connect each client
- [Overview](about/overview.md): what the assistant can do
- [Use cases](about/use-cases.md): questions by team
- [Tools](about/tools.md): every tool, cost and limit
- [Credits](about/credits.md): what is charged
- [Security and privacy](about/security-privacy.md): what travels where
- [Skill](skills/hippocampus/SKILL.md): how an assistant should use the tools
- [Developer docs](https://www.thalius.ai/developers/mcp): setup guides for each client
